messages:
Maya (CEO): FYI: quick all-hands this Wed 9:30am PT — 35m. Please skim agenda and drop Qs here or in the form. :calendar:
Maya (CEO): High-level agenda:
- 6m: Company pulse + hiring snapshot
- 12m: Product launch demo + failover walkthrough
- 6m: Policy update: data retention defaults (short overview)
- 8m: Roadmap highlights + live Q&A
- 3m: Close + next steps
Maya (CEO): Slides + preread: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/redwood-allhands-wed (view-only)
Ivy (People Ops): In-person seats + lunch signup: tinyurl.com/rw-allhands-wed — RSVP by Tue 3pm please.
Jamal (VP Product): For the demo we'll show Hosted -> Dedicated fallback and the canary flag. Posting sample prompts in the deck now.
Leila (Engineering Manager): Can we tack on one slide with the smoke-test checklist? I'll add it and tag QA.
Kendall (Head Eng): Infra will monitor burst metrics during demo. Tag #eng-runtime if anything odd appears.
Ops-bot: Calendar invite sent. Recording + auto-captions enabled. Reminder 15m before.
Maya (CEO): Quick policy note: default retention for internal dev orgs will change to 90 days; enterprise customers unaffected unless contract says otherwise. Security/legal cleared the change; official comms next week.
Jamal (VP Product): Draft runbook (WIP): https://docs.google.com/document/d/redwood-launch-runbook — feedback welcome.
Leila (Engineering Manager): I'll own the post-launch smoke tests and the rollback play. Adding owners to the runbook.
Maya (CEO): Please add any high-priority questions to the Q&A form (1-2 bullets): https://forms.gle/rw-allhands-qa-wed — we'll answer live where possible.
Maya (CEO): We'll post the recording and a short TL;DR on the wiki after the meeting. If you want your question anonymized in the digest, reply here with "anon".
Ops-bot: Action items will be created from the meeting and posted to the tracker after the call.
Maya (CEO): Thanks team — see you Wed or catch up via the recording. Thread will close in 72h with a final action summary. :sparkles:
